schemes.description: The traditional, most rigorous BIS certification route. Involves product testing at a BIS-recognized lab AND a physical factory inspection by a BIS officer before a license is granted. Applies to household appliances, cement, steel, toys, helmets, and most non-electronic notified products under Quality Control Orders (QCOs).
application_steps: Identify the applicable Indian Standard (IS number) for your product
Get your product tested at a BIS-recognized laboratory
Apply through the BIS Manak Online Portal (manakonline.bis.gov.in)
Undergo a factory inspection by a BIS officer
Submit required documents (business registration, test reports, quality control documentation)
Receive your CM/L license number and apply the ISI mark to your product
required_documents: In-house testing facility equipment calibration certificates
NABL Lab Test Report of sample
schemes.fee_info: Varies by product category and company size; MSME concessions available. Check current fee schedule on BIS Manak Online Portal.

schemes.description: Streamlined registration route specifically for electronics and IT products, administered by BIS under MeitY's Electronics and Information Technology Goods Order, 2021. Operates on lab testing + self-declaration — NO factory inspection required, since electronics move too fast for factory-inspection cycles.
application_steps: Confirm your product is on the MeitY CRS-notified list (70+ categories: laptops, phones, LED products, power banks, chargers, smartwatches, etc.)
Get your product tested at a BIS-recognized laboratory for the applicable IS standard
Submit test report and required information to BIS for registration
Apply the Standard Mark with R-Number to your product and packaging before sale
required_documents: BIS recognized NABL Lab Test Report (within 90 days)
Authorized Indian Representative (AIR) for foreign manufacturers
Undertaking for Compliance with BIS CRS Regulations
schemes.fee_info: Registration fee applies per product model, per manufacturer/brand — note: registration is NOT transferable, brand owners need their own registration even if using an OEM manufacturer

schemes.description: Applies to specific products notified under omnibus technical regulation orders, such as certain machinery and industrial equipment (e.g. packing machinery, weaving machinery, gear). Requires product testing and conformity assessment as prescribed by BIS.
application_steps: Confirm your product falls under a Scheme X notification
Get product tested and assessed per applicable conformity requirements
Apply through BIS with required documentation
schemes.timeline: Varies; check current BIS notifications for deadlines (some categories extended to Sept 2026)
